description: [$0.01] Token risk verdict & honeypot scan ($0.01/call — 50% cheaper than $0.02 verdicts): proxy upgradeability, owner renouncement, mint/blacklist/fee/trading-toggle bytecode, DEX liquidity, 0-100 score & AI grade. Live RPC bytecode + DEX, read-only; requires x402 USDC or Stripe MPP (10 free lifetime calls via /api/free/*) at 30-60 req/min.
